name: manual_b429cb
claim: Listing a file as a dependency or required_local_file is NOT the same as reading it. If .agent/AGENTS.md appears in your output (in a contract, a plan, a checklist), that is a signal you need to open and read it — not just acknowledge its existence. The same applies to any convention-defining file (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, README.md). Cargo-culting a filename into a list while skipping its content is how AFRP Trigger 3 failures happen.
conditions: reading vs listing AGENTS.md convention file cargo-cult AFRP trigger 3

decisions.notes: Directly observed in commit e74cce1c: agent added AGENTS.md to required_local_files in the endpoint-policy contract it had written to the wrong location. Knowing a file exists and reading it for behavioral guidance are different operations. 2026-07-04.
